command:
set -euo pipefail
    live="$HOME/qwen36/voice-stack/voice-tools-20260910"
    test ! -e rollback
    # The GPU unit reports failed since 16:19 UTC while its engines keep running
    # as orphans (journal: "remains running after unit stopped"), so the runbook
    # gate `systemctl --user is-active voice-stack-gpu2.service` cannot answer
    # the question it asks.  Ask the engines directly instead.
    for p in 8080/health 8090/health 8095/health; do
      code=$(curl -s -m 5 -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" "http://127.0.0.1:$p"); echo "engine $p -> $code"
      test "$code" = 200
    done
    systemctl --user --job-mode=ignore-dependencies stop voice-tools-bridge.service
    mkdir rollback
    rsync -a "$live/" rollback/
    touch rollback-complete
    rsync -aR web tools deploy scripts config README.md ARCHITECTURE.md RUNBOOK.md TOOLS.md PROVENANCE.md tests/README.md .guarded-run "$live/"
    cd "$live"
    python3 tools/voicectl.py --config config/host.toml index build
    python3 tools/voicectl.py --config config/host.toml doctor
label: install
